# Saviora

> Saviora is a modern personal finance and budget tracking SaaS platform designed to help individuals and households manage income, track daily expenses, plan monthly budgets, and reach savings goals with actionable financial analytics and privacy-first security.

## Overview

Saviora gives users full visibility and control over their personal finances. With intuitive income and expense logging, automated category budgeting, milestone savings targets, and health score analytics, Saviora makes financial management clear, simple, and stress-free.

- [Homepage](https://saviora.app): Overview of Saviora personal finance platform, interactive dashboard previews, and quick start.
- [Features](https://saviora.app/features): Income tracking, expense categorization, custom budget allocations, savings projections, and cash flow insights.
- [Income Tracker](https://saviora.app/income-tracker): Dedicated income tracker feature landing page for recording earnings, organizing income sources, and reviewing monthly income trends.
- [Pricing](https://saviora.app/pricing): Saviora Pro pricing details ($2.99/month or $29.99/year) with an introductory 90-day free trial. No credit card required.
- [About Us](https://saviora.app/about): Saviora's founding mission, values, and dedication to privacy-preserving financial management.
- [Contact Support](https://saviora.app/contact): Customer support desk, user feedback, and inquiry form.
